_about: The studio queue. Order = build priority. status: queued | building | first-playable | polishing | ready-to-play | shipped | parked. The site page and the loop both read this file.

games.title: Burn Down a Forest
games.tagline: A cursed forest swallowed the valley overnight. Burn it back with a match, then a torch, then a dragon.
games.note: Ship prep done (Godot 4.7.2, real ads and purchases with placeholder ids). Needs the owner's ids and store assets

games.title: Dig to the Core
games.tagline: Shovel, drill, laser. Dig straight down through fossils and a T. rex to the middle of the Earth.
games.note: Critic: almost. Polish pass in progress (rock textures, headlamp pool, set pieces, HUD vs tool, ending, lift ride)

games.title: Burn a Cardboard City
games.tagline: Someone built a whole city out of cardboard. It would be a shame if it caught fire.
games.note: Critic: almost (after polish 1). One more polish pass budgeted, then waits for owner feedback

games.title: Drain an Ocean
games.tagline: Pump the sea dry and watch shipwrecks, sunken treasure and finally Atlantis come up for air.
games.note: Critic: no. Fixes + full QA in progress

games.title: Eat a Giant Cake
games.tagline: You are tiny and the cake is enormous. Spoon, fork, stand mixer, through frosting, sponge and jam.
games.note: Paused before any files were written: no new game until the first is in App Review (North star)

games.title: Dust a Haunted House
games.tagline: A century of dust and cobwebs, and something is hiding under every layer.
games.note: Next new game when a slot opens after the first launch: cleaning is a proven satisfying theme and nothing in the catalog is like it (research/market.md)

games.title: Unbury a Pyramid
games.tagline: Blow away a desert of sand to uncover a buried pyramid, with mummies who help if you ask nicely.

games.title: Erase a Mountain
games.tagline: Chisel, dynamite, laser. Take a whole mountain apart and find the temple sealed inside.

games.title: Thaw a Frozen Planet
games.tagline: A whole tiny planet frozen solid. Walk all the way around it and bring summer back.
games.note: A melting game like the reference game: adds the least and carries similar-app review risk; could be a map in an existing game

games.title: Defrost a Freezer
games.tagline: You are tiny, the freezer is ancient, and somewhere under the ice is a pizza from 1987.
games.note: Closest to Melt a Glacier; may ship as a Melt a Glacier map instead of its own app

_order_reason: 2026-11-09: ordered by expected money per month per hour of work and how soon each can ship (research/market.md). Games in progress come first, closest to ready first; no new game starts until the first one is in App Review.
